name: Ecwid
description: Ecwid is an e-commerce platform that enables merchants to build online stores and integrate them across multiple sites, social media, and marketplaces.

evidence.claim: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to store data for public apps, along with simplified tokens for single-store customizations.
REST API accepts up to 600 requests per minute per token.
Community MCP server available powered by Pipedream Connect.

notes: Ecwid provides a comprehensive REST API supporting products, orders, categories, payment/shipping options, and rate limits up to 600 requests per minute.
search_queries_used: Ecwid authentication OAuth API key developer docs
